hints.text: At the start of the project, clones of flowers appear in random places on the map.
hints.title: The flowers appear

hints.text: The MarsBot is controlled from the keyboard while turning in the direction of the mouse cursor.
hints.title: Controlling the MarsBot with the mouse

hints.text: When you press the mouse, a clone of a drop of water is created and flies in the direction of the mouse until it touches the edge or a plant.
hints.title: A drop of water appears

hints.text: If a drop of water touches the plant, the plant gets bigger. The plant only grows to a certain size.
hints.title: The plant gets bigger
Weeds appear, the drops of water and fire change, fire appears.
*When you press the 1 key, single firing mode is activated, which means a second press of the key is required for a second shot.
*When you press the 2 key, continuous shooting mode is activated, which means you can hold down the mouse button and clones of drops will appear once every 0.1 seconds.
*When you press the 3 key, fan firing mode is activated, which means the clones of drops get a random deviation from the original direction.
